access_continuity_justification: The organization has three owners, fametrano, giacomocaironi and pmazzocchi, each an administrator of this repository. If one becomes unavailable, the other two can still close issues, merge changes and cut a release. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The launchers are plain-text numbered menus driven from the keyboard, with no colour, which a screen reader can read. The project site is GitHub. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#launcher-notes
assurance_case_justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md gives what is claimed, the threat model, the entry points, the trust boundaries, the secure design principles and the common implementation weaknesses with what counters each. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md
automated_integration_testing_justificat: test.yml runs tests/run.sh and the PowerShell tests that start no cmd.exe on Ubuntu, on every pull request and every push to main; its aggregate job `test: every job passed` is a required check. os-macos.yml and os-windows.yml run the macOS and Windows halves weekly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml
build_justification: Nothing is built: the launchers are scripts run as they are, and the binaries they start are the publishers' own. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md
build_preserve_debug_justification: There is no build or installation system: the folder is cloned or unzipped as it is. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#getting-the-folder
build_repeatable_justification: No building occurs: the scripts are used directly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md
build_reproducible_justification: No building occurs: the scripts are used directly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md
bus_factor_justification: fametrano made most of the commits and filed almost every issue. pmazzocchi, an organization owner, has made 16 commits and filed 11 issues (counted on 2026-11-12 with gh api 'repos/btclib-org/portanode/commits?author=pmazzocchi&per_page=100' --paginate -q '.[].sha' | wc -l and gh issue list -R btclib-org/portanode -s all -A pmazzocchi -L 500 --json state -q 'group_by(.state) | map({(.[0].state): length}) | add'). Knowledge of the code rests on fametrano alone. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/graphs/contributors
code_of_conduct_justification: btclib-org/.github's CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is this repository's code of conduct, through GitHub's organization-wide default; the community-profile API reports it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
code_review_standards_justification: REVIEWING.md states what a review checks, how a finding is written and what clears a pull request. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REVIEWING.md
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The required Lint check enforces the bash style on every .sh and .command script through the shellcheck and shfmt hooks, and trailing whitespace and the final newline in every text file. It enforces LF line endings in every text file but the .bat ones, which .gitattributes checks out with CRLF. The required Script security check enforces the PowerShell and batch styles. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
coding_standards_justification: The bash style is ShellCheck with every optional check but those CONTRIBUTING.md declines with their reasons, and shfmt's layout. The PowerShell style is PSScriptAnalyzer's default rule set at every severity. The batch style is Blinter's rules at every severity, except those CONTRIBUTING.md declines with its reasons. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the process: issues, one pull request per subject, the review and the landing. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the requirements: the Signed-off-by trailer, the gates that must pass, and REVIEWING.md, which the change is reviewed against. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contributors_unassociated_justification: fametrano is the only significant contributor; pmazzocchi, an organization owner, has made 16 commits and filed 11 issues (gh api 'repos/btclib-org/portanode/commits?author=pmazzocchi&per_page=100' --paginate -q '.[].sha' | wc -l and gh issue list -R btclib-org/portanode -s all -A pmazzocchi -L 500 --json state -q 'group_by(.state) | map({(.[0].state): length}) | add'), and is associated with fametrano: both are CheckSig co-founders, as their GitHub profiles state. icecold009 has made one commit, #742 (gh api 'repos/btclib-org/portanode/commits?author=icecold009&per_page=100' --paginate -q '.[].sha' | wc -l). The other committers are bots: Dependabot, pre-commit.ci and claude[bot], the pull-request agent. https://github.com/fametrano https://github.com/pmazzocchi
copyright_per_file_justification: Every script opens with the lines of COPYRIGHT, which name The btclib developers, and the copyright-notice hook in the required Lint check refuses one that does not. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/COPYRIGHT
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: Signatures are checked by gpg, which accepts the OpenPGP algorithms the publishers use, against the keyrings in keys/, which hold each publisher's key whatever its algorithm. A publisher's new key is a rewrite of its keyring, as README.md's Updating Binaries says. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
crypto_call_justification: Nothing is reimplemented: signatures are checked by gpg, and hashes computed by sha256sum, shasum or Get-FileHash. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/shared/utilities/lib.sh
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: No script turns certificate verification off: none passes --insecure, -k or -SkipCertificateCheck. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
crypto_credential_agility_justification: PortaNode processes no credential or private key: Bitcoin Core's RPC cookie and the wallets are Bitcoin Core's and Electrum's own. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/bitcoin-datadir/bitcoin.conf
crypto_floss_justification: Signature checks use GnuPG, which is FLOSS, and hashing uses the system's SHA-256 tools.
crypto_keylength_justification: PortaNode generates and selects no key. It checks the publishers' signatures against their keys, which the keyrings in keys/ hold. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
crypto_password_storage_justification: PortaNode stores no password for authenticating users. bitcoin.conf sets no RPC password. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/bitcoin-datadir/bitcoin.conf
crypto_pfs_justification: PortaNode implements no key agreement protocol.
crypto_published_justification: The software uses only OpenPGP signatures, checked by gpg, and SHA-256 checksums. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
crypto_random_justification: PortaNode generates no cryptographic key or nonce.
crypto_tls12_justification: On Windows, every download raises the session to TLS 1.2 where the protocol is not the system default (#730); curl on macOS and Linux supports TLS 1.2 and is restricted to HTTPS. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/pull/730
crypto_used_network_justification: Every download URL is HTTPS, and the Electrum local-server launcher connects over TLS. On macOS and Linux curl is called through curl_https, which restricts the protocol and every redirect to HTTPS. On Windows every download goes through win/scripts/utilities/fetch-https.ps1, which follows each redirect itself and refuses a URL or a redirect target that is not HTTPS (issue btclib-org/portanode#695, closed). https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/win/scripts/utilities/fetch-https.ps1 https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/shared/utilities/lib.sh
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: Certificates are verified before any request, and no request carries a cookie or credential. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
crypto_weaknesses_justification: A signature counts only where its hash algorithm is none of MD5, SHA-1 and RIPEMD-160 (OpenPGP algorithms 1, 2 and 3), read from gpg's VALIDSIG line by shared/utilities/lib.sh and win/scripts/utilities/lib.bat, and the tests refuse each. The signers' public keys are pinned byte for byte in keys/, and gpg verifies against them alone, so which key counts is decided by those bytes, not by an OpenPGP v4 fingerprint, which is SHA-1 over the key, nor by the key's self-signatures, which are part of those bytes: a forged one would have to reach keys/ through a pull request. Measured with gpg 2.5.24 --list-packets: the Electrum release key in keys/electrum.gpg carries SHA-1 self-signatures, its three user-ID certifications and its subkey binding; the keys in keys/bitcoin-core.gpg carry SHA-256 or SHA-512 ones. Electrum 4.8.4's signatures on its AppImage use SHA-256 or SHA-512, the release key's SHA-512 made by its primary key, so no subkey binding is used, and Bitcoin Core 32.1's SHA256SUMS.asc uses SHA-256 throughout. The downloads are checked with SHA-256. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
crypto_working_justification: No script uses MD4, MD5, DES or RC4: the checks are OpenPGP signatures against the public keys in keys/, and SHA-256 checksums. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
dco_justification: main requires the Sign-off check, which refuses a pull request with a commit that lacks its author's Signed-off-by: trailer. CONTRIBUTING.md links the DCO. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests
delivery_mitm_justification: The project is delivered from GitHub over HTTPS, and each release is a signed tag. The updaters download over HTTPS and check PGP signatures. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over HTTP: every download URL is HTTPS. Bitcoin Core's SHA256SUMS is used only after its PGP signature is checked. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot alerts and security updates are on, and Dependency review is a required check. Bitcoin Core and Electrum are not pinned: the updaters fetch each publisher's latest release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml
description_good_justification: README.md says PortaNode runs Bitcoin Core and Electrum from one folder on an external disk that macOS, Windows and Linux share. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests: searchable, addressable by URL, open to anyone. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues
documentation_achievements_justification: README.md links the OpenSSF Scorecard, Best Practices and Baseline badges on the lines the organization standard reserves for them. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md
documentation_architecture_justification: README.md's Folder Structure and Launcher Notes describe the root launchers, the per-platform menus and scripts, the bin/ directories and the data directories, and how a launcher reaches each. ASSURANCE_CASE.md's Entry points and Secure design principles describe the shared library under shared/ and the signers' keyrings under keys/. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#folder-structure https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md#entry-points
documentation_basics_justification: README.md covers getting the folder, the quick start, each launcher, updating, troubleshooting and the security notes. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md
documentation_current_justification: REVIEWING.md blocks a pull request on a false sentence in the tree's documentation, and links.yml checks every link weekly. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REVIEWING.md
documentation_interface_justification: README.md and the macos/, win/ and linux/ README.md files describe every launcher, its menu, the environment variables and the keyrings in keys/. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md
documentation_roadmap_justification: ROADMAP.md, organization-wide, says portanode is maintained as it is, with no new features planned; it is reviewed every September. README.md links it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_security_justification: README.md says what a user can and cannot expect: Updating Binaries says the PGP check fails closed, and Limitations, not vulnerabilities says checksums give integrity only, the folder is unencrypted and the launchers are unsigned. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#limitations-not-vulnerabilities
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The suite runs under kcov before each release, with the scripts as they ship: no configuration turns on extra assertions for the analysis. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/kcov.sh
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No tool that this project counts as dynamic analysis runs, so it has found nothing. The suite under kcov only measures line coverage. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/kcov.sh
dynamic_analysis_justification: The suite runs under coverage.yml before each tag: RELEASING.md's Cutting one dispatches it and stops where the run fails. It reports which bash lines, under kcov, and which .ps1 statements the suite ran. It varies no input and does not see the .bat files, so it is not counted here as a dynamic analysis tool. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md#cutting-one
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The project produces no software in a memory-unsafe language: it is bash, batch and PowerShell. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
english_justification: All documentation is in English, and issues are taken in English. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are issues like any other, and are answered or closed. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed
external_dependencies_justification: dependencies.yaml lists, in YAML, each program the launchers and utilities start that the folder does not hold, with its platforms, whether it is required and what it is for. README.md's Prerequisites names the same programs, and tests/sh/dependencies.sh, in the suite, fails where the two differ. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/dependencies.yaml https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#prerequisites https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/tests/sh/dependencies.sh
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
governance_justification: GOVERNANCE.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, documents the decision model and the roles; README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md link it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
hardened_site_justification: The project site, https://btclib.org/portanode/, and the repository on GitHub both send Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and X-Frame-Options: deny. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
hardening_justification: On macOS and Linux the update, rollback, verify and validate scripts run under set -euo pipefail, so an unexpected failure stops them. The PGP check fails closed. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/linux/scripts/utilities/update-bitcoin.sh
implement_secure_design_justification: Fail-safe defaults: an update without enough good signatures from pinned keys is refused, and a rollback refuses to run while the node is up. No updater rewrites a checksum entry. set-permissions restricts the data directories to the owner where the filesystem allows. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
input_validation_justification: Menus accept only their listed numbers and reject anything else. A version that is not digits and dots refuses the update, and so does a SHA256SUMS holding no entry of 64 hex digits whose name field is the downloaded file's name, whole. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
installation_common_justification: PortaNode is a portable folder: git clone or the ZIP of main installs it, and deleting the folder removes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#getting-the-folder
installation_development_quick_justifica: git clone, then uv: CONTRIBUTING.md's The environment and the gates gives the uvx commands that run every gate. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-environment-and-the-gates
installation_standard_variables_justific: There is no installer that writes outside the folder; the folder may sit anywhere, and PORTANODE_ROOT overrides where it is looked for. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#environment-overrides
interact_justification: README.md says how to get the folder, how to report a bug and how to contribute. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
interfaces_current_justification: No script calls wmic, Get-WmiObject, egrep or fgrep. Downloads use curl and Invoke-WebRequest. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
internationalization_justification: Every message and menu is in English only. The maintainer decided on 2026-11-11 to leave this criterion unmet. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues/873#issuecomment-6790238478
know_common_errors_justification: The primary developer counters the common shell errors: shellcheck gates every .sh and .command script, the macOS and Linux updaters run under set -euo pipefail, and the signature check refuses an update where the keyring in keys/ is missing or empty, or where gpg's status lines for one signature disagree. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
know_secure_design_justification: The primary developer designed the updaters to fail closed: an install needs good signatures from enough distinct pinned keys, and checksums are appended only after that. README.md's Limitations, not vulnerabilities states the trust model. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#limitations-not-vulnerabilities
license_per_file_justification: Every script opens with the lines of COPYRIGHT, which say the code is under the MIT license and link its text, and the copyright-notice hook in the required Lint check refuses one that does not. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/LICENSE
maintenance_or_update_justification: Only the latest release is supported. Upgrading is pulling the folder again, and RELEASE_NOTES.md says what a user must act on. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md
no_leaked_credentials_justification: detect-secrets and detect-private-key run in the required Lint check, and secret scanning has no alert. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.secrets.baseline
osps_ac_01_01_justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member and accepts only secure methods, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882
osps_ac_02_01_justification: A new member gets read access, the organization's base permission (gh api orgs/btclib-org --jq .default_repository_permission). This repository has no direct collaborator. A higher grant is an issue in btclib-org/.github that an owner other than the one asking approves. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#how-a-decision-is-made
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires a pull request for every change to main. Its one bypass actor, fametrano, holds it in pull_request mode, which excuses the approval but still refuses a direct push, so nobody pushes to main directly. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/2021
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The main-integrity ruleset forbids deleting main and has no bypass actor. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#rulesets
osps_ac_04_01_justification: The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only and cannot approve pull requests (gh api repos/btclib-org/portanode/actions/permissions/workflow). Every workflow also sets permissions: contents: read at the top. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#token-permissions
osps_ac_04_02_justification: Every workflow sets permissions: contents: read at the top. These jobs add scopes: claude-review (pull-requests: write and id-token: write), claude-implement (issues: write and id-token: write), codeql and scorecard (security-events: write, scorecard also id-token: write, both actions: read), and the test and codeql aggregates (actions: read, to read their own run's jobs). zizmor's excessive-permissions audit runs in the required Lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/claude-review.yml
osps_br_01_01_justification: No workflow uses pull_request_target or workflow_run. No run: step expands an event field; verified-signatures.yml's inputs reach a script only through env:. zizmor's template-injection audit runs in the required Lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull-request runs use the pull_request and pull_request_review_comment triggers, which give a fork no secrets and a read-only token. The review job, which holds a secret, runs only when the head repository is this one. On issue_comment, the mention job checks out the default branch. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-claude-review.yml
osps_br_01_04_justification: Only verified-signatures.yml takes workflow_dispatch inputs, before and after. They reach the script through env:, and the script refuses any value that is not a hex commit sha. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-verified-signatures.yml
osps_br_02_01_justification: Each release has a unique calendar version, YYYY.M.D, set by a signed v* tag. A fix to a shipped release is another day's release. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASING.md#the-version-string
osps_br_02_02_justification: The only asset of a release is GitHub's source archive, named after the tag: portanode-2026.11.13.zip for v2026.11.13. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/releases/latest
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every official channel is served over HTTPS only: the home page at btclib.org, whose plain HTTP redirects to HTTPS, the GitHub repository, its issue tracker, its Security tab and its releases. https://btclib.org/portanode/ https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode
osps_br_03_02_justification: The project is distributed only from GitHub, over HTTPS: git clone, the ZIP of main and the release's source archive. Each release is a signed tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/releases
osps_br_04_01_justification: The GitHub release body is RELEASE_NOTES.md's section for that release: what a user must act on. CHANGELOG.md lists what changed. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md
osps_br_05_01_justification: No build ingests a dependency, and a release is a tag. CI installs its tools with pre-commit at the revisions .pre-commit-config.yaml pins, and every third-party action is pinned by commit SHA. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml
osps_br_06_01_justification: Each release is a signed annotated tag, and GitHub verifies its signature. The tag covers the commit and every file in it. The source archive GitHub generates carries no signature of its own. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/tags
osps_br_07_01_justification: Secret scanning and its push protection are on. The detect-private-key and detect-secrets hooks run in the required Lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#security-settings
osps_br_07_02_justification: A secret is an environment secret that only the owners reach. A secret kept in any other store is recorded in the REPOSITORY.md of the repository that uses it, and btclib-org/.github's tests/secrets_test.py refuses an unrecorded one. A secret is rotated when an owner changes or an exposure is suspected. The secrets kept outside an environment are rotated before they are a year old, and the list is reviewed yearly. This repository holds no secret of its own. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md#secrets
osps_do_01_01_justification: README.md is the user guide: getting the folder, the quick start, each launcher, updating and rolling back the binaries, and troubleshooting. macos/README.md, win/README.md and linux/README.md say what holds on one platform. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md
osps_do_02_01_justification: README.md's Getting Help says to search the open issues and file through the bug form. CONTRIBUTING.md's The issue tracker says where an issue goes, and the security policy sends a vulnerability to a private channel. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml
osps_do_03_01_justification: VERIFYING.md tells a user how to check a release: import the maintainer's key from GitHub, compare its fingerprint, then run git verify-tag on a clone. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/VERIFYING.md
osps_do_03_02_justification: VERIFYING.md names the key a release tag is signed by, by fingerprint, and the earlier, revoked key apart. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/VERIFYING.md
osps_do_04_01_justification: The security policy's Supported versions says that only the latest release is supported, nothing is backported, and a fix is a new release. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_do_05_01_justification: The security policy: only the latest release is supported, so a release stops receiving security updates when the next one is published. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md#supported-versions
osps_do_06_01_justification: README.md's Updating Binaries says how Bitcoin Core and Electrum are obtained and verified: from their publishers, with PGP signatures from pinned keys. .github/dependabot.yml says how the actions are tracked, and .pre-commit-config.yaml's ci: block how the hook revisions are. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#updating-binaries
osps_do_07_01_justification: Nothing is built: README.md's Getting the folder and Updating Binaries say how to assemble a working folder, and Prerequisites names gpg. CONTRIBUTING.md gives the development environment: uv, then uvx pre-commit. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/README.md#getting-the-folder
osps_gv_01_01_justification: btclib-org/.github's GOVERNANCE.md, *Roles*, names who holds access to sensitive resources: fametrano is the maintainer, and the three owners, named by login, administer every repository. This repository has no direct collaborator. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles
osps_gv_01_02_justification: btclib-org/.github's GOVERNANCE.md, *Roles*, describes the maintainer, owners, repository collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

GOVERNANCE.md reserves that bypass for an emergency, and it is used for ordinary work: over the last two releases, 30 of the 32 pull requests merged had no approval from anybody other than their author (v2026.11.7 13 of 14, v2026.11.2 17 of 18). osps_vm_01_01_justification: The security policy's Reporting a vulnerability gives the private channels and the timeframes: a report is acknowledged within 7 days, and a fix or a published advisory follows within 90 days. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy

vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The security policy on the Security tab, the organization's SECURITY.md, gives the process. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability was reported from outside the project: organization owners filed each issue labelled security from their own review. Each was closed within 14 days of filing, the slowest in 13.92 days (measured with gh issue list -R btclib-org/portanode -s all -l security -L 500 --json createdAt,closedAt -q 'map((.closedAt|fromdate) - (.createdAt|fromdate)) | max / 86400'). https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Asecurity
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: The security policy gives the private channels, who sees a report, and the timeframes for acknowledgement and fix. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/security/policy
warnings_fixed_justification: shellcheck findings fail the required Lint check. Script security fails on any PSScriptAnalyzer finding not suppressed in the script with its reason (ISS 755), and on any finding of Blinter's Error, Security and Warning rules that the baseline does not hold; each accepted Warning rule has its reason in .github/blinter-reasons.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/script-security.yml
warnings_justification: shellcheck reads every .sh and .command script in the required Lint check. The required Script security check runs PSScriptAnalyzer's default rules on the .ps1 scripts and the Blinter rules of the batch style on the .bat scripts. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/script-security.yml
warnings_strict_justification: shellcheck runs on every .sh and .command script with every optional check but those CONTRIBUTING.md declines with their reasons, and a finding fails the required Lint check. The required Script security check runs PSScriptAnalyzer's default rules and Blinter's rules at every severity, except those the batch style declines. A finding of either at any severity fails it, PSScriptAnalyzer's Information and Blinter's Style included, unless Blinter's baseline holds it. https://github.com/btclib-org/portanode/blob/main/.github/workflows/script-security.yml
